title: My phone battery doesn't die. It performs.
hidden_world: 1% battery opera theater inside the phone
style: Character Chaos — adult-animation, self-aware, Version B
tone: absurd-deadpan, short punchy lines, adult-animation energy, no childish filler

lip_sync_policy.current_approach: prompt-based mouth movement — Kling does not support audio-driven lip-sync natively
lip_sync_policy.requirement: Every scene with dialogue must explicitly request visible mouth movement in the visual prompt
talking_rules: talking character must face camera or 3/4 toward camera
mouth open/close animation during voice line — explicitly stated in prompt
no hidden mouth, no back-facing character during dialogue
no tiny distant talking character — medium or close-up required for dialogue scenes
visible mouth movement required on every dialogue beat
lip_sync_policy.future_plan: If prompt-based mouth movement is insufficient after QC, add a lip-sync tool pass (e.g. LatentSync or SadTalker-style) between Kling output and voice mix — do not attempt live until this plan is approved

brand_safety.visual_rule: No real Spotify logo, no real app icons, no real phone UI (iOS/Android), no readable brand text anywhere in generated clips
brand_safety.app_icon_audience: Generic colored square/circle characters with simple expressive faces — no real app resemblance
brand_safety.battery_icon: Generic battery bar shape — do not render real iOS or Android 1% UI

battery.name: Battery
battery.color: pale faded yellow/white — solid opaque, NOT transparent, NOT glowing orb
battery.face: large expressive eyes, deep V-shaped suffering eyebrows, wide open mouth in theatrical aria pose
battery.costume: large flowing red opera cape, clearly visible and billowing
battery.pose: one hand pressed to forehead (anguish), other arm extended toward spotlight above
battery.energy: absolute commitment to the drama — no irony in delivery — tiny Pavarotti who hasn't eaten
battery.voice: tiny operatic cartoonish tenor, deliberate, each word a performance, slight reverb (theater hall effect), slight rasp on held notes
battery.size_in_frame: dominant — fills at least 50% of frame height in solo shots, 40% in two-shots

charger.name: Charger
charger.color: bright orange/yellow — strong contrast against pale battery
charger.face: large panicking eyes (whites showing), mouth open mid-shout, eyebrows raised in disbelief
charger.costume: cable body IS the costume — plug end = head/face, cable body = body
charger.pose: running in from stage right, arms (cable ends) outstretched toward battery
charger.energy: exhausted stage manager who has watched this happen 47 times, patience completely gone
charger.voice: fast, strained, going higher as panic increases, dry with no reverb — immediate and present
charger.size_in_frame: secondary — enters from edge, reaches medium prominence in confrontation scenes

audience.name: App Icon Audience
audience.type: generic colored square/circle characters with simple dot eyes and small mouths
audience.color: varied muted colors — no real app brand colors
audience.rule: NO real app logos, NO recognizable icons, NO text, NO brand resemblance
audience.size_in_frame: small, background only, fills depth of stage — expressive reactions but never dominant

scene_breakdown.name: HOOK
scene_breakdown.visual_action: Unbranded generic black smartphone sits on a surface. No real logos. Battery corner shows low/empty bar (no text, no real UI). Camera slowly pushes toward screen. Transition: screen becomes a stage curtain parting.
captions:
It didn't ask
to be charged.
scene_breakdown.sfx: soft phone ambient hum + single low piano note
scene_breakdown.visual_clarity_note: Phone must read as generic — no Apple/Samsung/brand markings. Battery indicator is visual only (depleted bar), not text-rendered by Kling. Camera push creates anticipation.

scene_breakdown.name: REVEAL
scene_breakdown.visual_action: Red velvet curtain parts revealing a small opera stage inside the phone. CENTER STAGE in spotlight: Battery character — pale white/faded yellow, large flowing RED opera cape, one hand pressed to forehead in anguish, other arm extended toward spotlight, large expressive suffering eyes, deep V eyebrows, mouth wide open in aria. Generic colored square/circle app icon audience visible in background — small, expressive reactions, no real logos. Wooden stage planks floor.

voice_lines.mouth_note: mouth wide open on 'everything', visible from medium shot
staccato delivery, mouth opens and closes on each word

scene_breakdown.sfx: mini cartoonish orchestral swell (not real opera — cartoonish version) + tiny audience murmur
scene_breakdown.visual_clarity_note: Battery must fill at least 50% of frame height. Opera cape RED and large — billowing. Face fully readable. App icon audience stays in background, darker, smaller. Spotlight must be visible as a cone of light. Stage wooden floor establishes world in one glance.
scene_breakdown.mouth_movement_note: Battery facing camera or 3/4 camera. Mouth open/close clearly visible during 'I gave everything' and 'Every percent. Every bar.' Must be readable at medium shot.

scene_breakdown.name: BUILD / CHARGER ENTERS
scene_breakdown.visual_action: Battery continues monologue center stage — hand still to forehead, other arm reaching up to spotlight. STAGE RIGHT: Charger cable character RUNS IN — bright orange, plug end is face (large panicking eyes, mouth open mid-shout), cable body moving like legs, arms (cable ends) outstretched toward Battery. Battery does NOT look at Charger. Charger gets closer but Battery stays in performance mode.

voice_lines.mouth_note: slow dramatic delivery, mouth barely open on 'WiFi', full open on 'tried' — facing camera

voice_lines.line: You're literally next to the outlet.
voice_lines.mouth_note: fast panicked delivery, mouth wide open, plug face toward camera or 3/4

captions:
You're literally
next to the outlet.
scene_breakdown.sfx: charger running footsteps on stage floor + tiny audience gasp
scene_breakdown.visual_clarity_note: Two characters must be clearly different: pale white battery vs bright orange charger. Battery large and central, charger smaller and approaching from side. Both face camera enough for mouth to be visible. Action: battery performing, charger panicking — two clear emotional states readable at once.
scene_breakdown.mouth_movement_note: BOTH characters must show visible mouth movement during their lines. Battery: slow, theatrical. Charger: fast, panicked. Neither character may have mouth clamped shut during their voice line.

scene_breakdown.name: CONFRONTATION / THE PUNCHLINE
scene_breakdown.visual_action: Charger reaches Battery and grabs its arm. Battery pulls away slowly without breaking performance. MEDIUM TWO-SHOT. Charger POINTS off-stage left (toward 'the outlet') — exaggerated pointing gesture, face contorted with frustration, veins showing on cable. Battery, without opening eyes: 'I'm in the middle of something.' Charger: 'You're at ONE PERCENT.' Battery (still performing, eyes closed): 'Those are the same thing.' Charger holds own head with both cable-hands in total disbelief. App icon audience visible in background — leaning forward, shocked.

voice_lines.line: I'm in the middle of something.
voice_lines.mouth_note: deadpan, eyes still closed or barely open — but mouth visible and moving
cracking voice, mouth wide, plug face toward camera
THE LINE — calm, eyes still closed, mouth barely moving — understated delivery is the joke. Mouth movement minimal but visible.

captions:
I'm in the middle
of something.
scene_breakdown.caption_note: 'Those are the same thing.' rendered at larger font size — this is the key punchline
scene_breakdown.sfx: tiny audience GASP on 'those are the same thing' + brief silence after the line
scene_breakdown.visual_clarity_note: THIS IS THE KEY SCENE. The confrontation must be readable: charger points (gesture clear), battery ignores (body language clear). Both faces visible. 'Those are the same thing' must land in silence — brief SFX pause after the line. Charger's head-hold reaction must read as total defeat.
scene_breakdown.mouth_movement_note: All three lines require visible mouth movement on speaking character. Charger: face camera or 3/4. Battery: can be slightly profile but mouth movement still readable. NO line can be delivered with mouth fully closed.

scene_breakdown.name: COLLAPSE + BUTTON
scene_breakdown.visual_action: Battery begins theatrical collapse — slow fall backwards, one arm still outstretched toward spotlight, red cape BILLOWING, spotlight tightens on falling battery. Battery whispers: 'Tell Spotify I loved her.' [audio says 'Spotify', caption shows 'Spotily']. Charger lunges to catch Battery — arms outstretched, horrified expression — but Battery falls anyway with full theatrical commitment. STAGE GOES DARK. Single clean low-battery chime sound. ONE BEAT OF SILENCE. Caption appears on black: 'Should I charge it or let it have this?'

voice_lines.line: You've been at one percent for six hours.
voice_lines.mouth_note: exhausted, defeated — quieter than before, plug face visible
eyes closed, whisper delivery, mouth barely moving — but visible
final whisper, slow, mouth gently opens and closes on each word

captions:
Should I charge it
or let it have this?
scene_breakdown.sfx: cape billowing swoosh + soft stage thud as battery collapses + SINGLE ORIGINAL low-battery chime (NOT Apple/Samsung exact sound) + 0.5s complete silence + caption appears
scene_breakdown.visual_clarity_note: Collapse must read as theatrical/funny — not sad or violent. Cape billowing = visual comedy. Charger's lunging arms = frustrated helplessness. Dark transition must happen AFTER collapse is fully visible — not during. Final caption on black for 2 seconds minimum.
scene_breakdown.mouth_movement_note: Battery's final lines are whispered — mouth movement subtle but visible on close shot. Charger's line delivered at medium shot facing camera.

production_risks.risk: Battery rendered transparent or as a glowing orb
production_risks.fix: Prompt must say: solid opaque pale faded yellow/white body, NOT transparent, NOT a glowing orb, NOT ethereal — solid character with visible mass

production_risks.risk: Opera cape too small to read
production_risks.fix: Prompt: large flowing red opera cape, occupies significant portion of character, clearly visible and billowing, cape larger than character torso

production_risks.risk: Charger rendered as just a cable with no face
production_risks.fix: Prompt: orange USB/lightning cable character, round face on the plug end, large round panicking eyes on plug face, mouth open on plug face, cable body acts as the body with arm extensions

production_risks.risk: App icon audience shows real logos (Spotify green, Netflix red, etc.)
production_risks.fix: Prompt: generic abstract colored square and circle characters, NO real app logos, NO brand colors, NO recognizable icons, NO text on any audience member, simple expressive dot eyes

production_risks.risk: Mouth movement invisible or mouth closed during dialogue
production_risks.fix: Every dialogue scene prompt must include: 'visible mouth open and closing during speech, character faces camera or 3/4 angle, mouth animation clearly readable from medium shot'

production_risks.risk: Real battery UI text rendered by Kling in scene 1
production_risks.fix: Do NOT ask Kling to render '1%' text. Battery level communicated by near-empty bar shape only. Text added in post/caption if needed.

production_risks.risk: Scene 5 dark transition obscures collapse action
production_risks.fix: Prompt: lights fade to black ONLY after battery is visibly collapsed on stage floor — do not fade during the collapse action, cut to black cleanly after

production_risks.risk: Two characters too similar in color if Kling drifts
production_risks.fix: Explicitly state: 'Battery = pale faded white/yellow. Charger = bright vivid orange. These two colors must never overlap or be confused. Strong chromatic contrast required.'
